name: bd_camp
style: Melancholic campfire theme for a ruined underground camp, instrumental: a solo nylon-string guitar plays a slow, tender melody, a warm cello answers softly underneath, faint crackle-like brushed percussion, intimate and a little sad but comforting, steady for looping, ends on a soft resolved chord.

name: bd_dungeon
style: Dark gothic dungeon exploration theme, instrumental: a low cello ostinato carries the pulse, sparse muted piano notes drip above it, a distant wordless male choir pad swells and fades, slow heavy frame drum hits every few bars, tense and grim but restrained, steady tempo for looping, ends on a sustained low drone.
